verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a server-to-server HTTP ingestion API (jitsu-docs-2) and backs it with delivery guarantees: deduplication, Kafka-backed buffering during warehouse outages, and a dead-letter queue with reprocessing for failed events (jitsu-docs-8, jitsu-docs-9, jitsu-docs-16), plus sub-second delivery speed (jitsu-docs-7). However, the evidence pack does not explicitly document the authentication mechanism (e.g., write keys/tokens) for this specific ingestion endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit authentication scheme documentation for the HTTP ingestion endpoint, independent/hands-on verification of delivery guarantees in production.
